page.overview:
Who is Arvy Motorhome?

Arvy Motorhome is a coach who takes part in the demolition derby at the Thunder Hollow Speedway in Cars 3.

He is seen chasing Lightning and Cruz. Later, he crashes into Faregame and spins around. He is later eliminated by falling on his left side with Pushover.

He appears in Miss Fritter's Racing Skoool, he interrumps Pushover's interview, later he gets kicked out by Miss Fritter in the commercial and he celebrates.
